rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCPAmpel scans MCP server configurations for security vulnerabilities by querying 16 scanning engines and computing aggregated trust scores. It discovers MCP server definitions from Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Gemini CLI configuration files. Requires an mcpampel.com API key with a free tier of 50 calls per day.
